column3: Live overlay pinning deepseek-v4-flash, inserting the llm-replay provider, and reproducing the /tmp sandbox fallback root behind a passthrough sandbox runner.

Live overlay pointing the sandbox policy at /tmp as a process-level fallback while the generated session cwd lives outside the temp grants; mode from DSH_PERMISSION_MODE with a snapshot-time danger-full-access default.
Two scripted model turns: a write tool call for session-root.txt, then a DONE text turn, each with usage and a finish reason.
Format-v2 parent: the system prompt travels in the request header, the write tool result is a user-role message with tool-result content, the turn ends completed after two steps.
Format-v3 parent: the system prompt becomes a system/message record in the surface and leaves the request header; the tool result gains meta.operation=create.
Format-v4 parent: system message sourced system-prompt, runtime context becomes its own runtime-context source with named sections, tool result is a role=tool message with toolCallId and meta.path.
Scenario manifest: pins the session-sandbox-root header class, reuses text-turn prompt and tool-schema sidecars, requires a replay override, workspace-write permission and a final workspace oracle.
Independent oracle: the file the write tool must leave behind, containing exactly the text session root.
Format-v2 skill turn: a skill-catalog user message lists available skills before the model calls the skill tool, and the result is a user-role message carrying the skill_content block.
Format-v3 twin of the skill turn; the only structural change from v2 is the system-message record and the request header dropping the system field.
Format-v4 twin; system message sourced system-prompt, runtime context its own source, and the skill tool result is a role=tool message.
Scenario manifest pinning the skill header class and reusing text-turn sidecars; workspace seeded by the editing-cordis-skill setup.
Skill seed marked user-invocable false whose whole job is to prove a user-disabled skill is still advertised to the model.
Plain project skill seed with no invocation flag, exercising discovery and loading of a workspace .dsh/skills entry.
Skill seed marked disable-model-invocation true whose job is to prove a model-disabled skill stays out of the model catalog.

Live overlay mounting the real subagent-acp provider against a mock ACP server with permission reject, exposed as the subagent_acp tool with provider-managed depth.
Three scripted parent turns: two subagent_acp calls (first and second failure) then a PARENT_OBSERVED_ACP_DIAGNOSTIC text turn.

Format-v3 parent: adds the subagent/catalog record but keeps the synchronous cancellation error and the job_output collect.
Format-v4 parent: subagent_acp always backgrounds, the tool result is only started subagent, and the denial arrives as a subagent-settled notice spliced into the next step inbox.
Scenario plugin that awaits ctx.subagents.waitForChildren inside a tools/execute middleware so each ACP terminal record and notice lands BEFORE its delegation tool result.

Expected advertised tool-schema set, 27 tools including subagent_acp; read the file header and the complete tool-name list, not every schema body.
Replay twin of the preset overlay plus the llm-replay provider and the passthrough sandbox runner.
